decision.reasoning_trace: In this session, I evaluated a variety of Bluetooth speakers ranging from ultra-portable mini speakers to specialized neckband and bike speakers. While the EWA A106 Pro (prod_bluetooth_speakers_192) offers significant social proof and the Raymate (prod_bluetooth_speakers_153) provides higher wattage at a reasonable price, a recurring theme in the reviews for many of these products was reliability concerns, such as units failing after a few months or batteries not meeting advertised durations. Specifically, the ZEALOT (prod_bluetooth_speakers_142) and Monster (prod_bluetooth_speakers_183) had reports of speakers blowing or sides failing quickly. Given these durability concerns and my target for a reliable audio solution, I have decided to forgo a purchase in this session to research higher-tier brands or wait for more robust options.
